answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 6247 Country: India Title: I am going to marry in one or two years. my fiance is two years older than me. we r in love and going to marry which our parents have aproved. is it unislamic to marry withyour choice girl and elder than you. also she is my cousin. Question: I am going to marry in one or two years. my fiance is two years older than me. we r in love and going to marry which our parents have aproved. is it unislamic to marry withyour choice girl and elder than you. also she is my cousin. Answer ID: 6247 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 543/543=M/1429) It is lawful to marry a girl elder than you, as the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) married Hazrat Khadeejah ( رضی اللہ عنھا ), but talking to your fianc?e unnecessarily, meeting and walking with her is un-Islamic and unlawful, so you should avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
